products.name: Datadog Deployment for Hybrid & Cloud Estates — Commercial
products.short_description: Roll out Datadog across hybrid and multicloud — agents, integrations, dashboards, and monitors that give one pane of glass over everything.
products.description:
Roll out Datadog across hybrid and multicloud — agents, integrations, dashboards, and monitors that give one pane of glass over everything.

Teams running Azure, AWS, and on-prem end up with fragmented monitoring and no single view. This solution deploys Datadog across the estate — agent rollout (hybrid + cloud), cloud integrations (Azure/AWS/Kubernetes), curated dashboards, and monitors/alerting with sensible thresholds — managed as code so the observability stack is versioned and repeatable.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run automation (Terraform, CLI & scripts).

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Datadog agent rollout (VMs, containers/Kubernetes, hybrid) as code
  • Cloud integrations — Azure, AWS, and Kubernetes metrics/logs
  • Curated dashboards and Service Level Objectives (SLOs)
  • Monitors and alerting with tuned thresholds and notification routing
  • Log pipelines and APM foundations, managed via Terraform

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

One pane of glass over Azure, AWS, and on-prem — deployed as versioned code, not a pile of hand-clicked monitors.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 4 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Install-DatadogAgent.ps1 — install/uninstall the Datadog Agent on Windows (white-label)
    • OBSDDOG-Report.ps1 — Datadog inventory/coverage report via the API (read-only)
    • OBSDDOG-Validate.ps1 — verify the Datadog deployment and that NO keys live in code (read-only)
    • install-datadog-agent.sh — install/uninstall the Datadog Agent on Linux (white-label)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
